I want to know the small things you don’t think matter.
the tiny, ordinary, almost forgettable parts of you.
like whether you wear your socks before your pants, whether you check the door twice before leaving, what song you secretly sing in the shower, how you eat when you’re fully comfortable, and what crosses your mind right before sleep finds you.

because love, to me, isn’t just in the big moments. it’s in noticing the details you don’t perform for the world.
i want to know you so completely, in the ways you’re not even aware of yourself.

I love observational intimacy.

Share this to the person who didn’t marry a calm girl. 
he married someone who feels everything deeply.

someone who says “mujhe kuch nahi hua” while clearly holding back tears.

someone who says “i’m leaving” and forgets her shoes behind.

someone who can go from angry… to laughing… to needing a hug within the same minute.

but he never made me feel “too much” for it.

somehow, he always understood that my silence needed softness, not distance.

he learned that 
“mujhe kuch nahi hua” actually means 
“bas thoda aur paas baitho na.”

and no matter how dramatic my emotions looked from outside, he always handled them with love instead of irritation.

maybe love isn’t finding someone calm. 
maybe it’s finding someone patient enough to hold your chaos gently 🤍
